description: This file provides support functions for integrating various frameworks and platform-specific features into the Kivy event loop, including GObject iteration, Android platform hooks, and Twisted reactor management.

methods.name: install_gobject_iteration
methods.description: Imports and installs GObject context iteration into the Kivy event loop, enabling GObject-based frameworks like GStreamer to run smoothly.

methods.name: install_android
methods.description: Sets up hooks for Android platform integration, including handling pause/resume and device key mappings.

methods.name: install_twisted_reactor
methods.description: Installs a threaded Twisted reactor that integrates with the Kivy event loop, allowing Twisted tasks to run cooperatively.

methods.name: uninstall_twisted_reactor
methods.description: Uninstalls the previously installed Twisted reactor, cleaning up resources and stopping Twisted tasks.
